Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: compact faction emblem for an existing dark tactical strategy game UI. Edit the supplied reference into ONE production UI badge, square composition. Keep the faction's recognizable central identity, simplify fine engraving and tiny elements so the symbol reads crisply at 32 to 48 pixels. Bold silhouette, generous separation between parts, restrained metallic bevel, clean sharp edges. Subject occupies about 80% of canvas, centered with an even transparent margin. Genuine transparent background; no environmental background, no rectangular panel, no vignette, no drop shadow outside the emblem, no words, no letters, no numbers, no caption, no watermark. Deliver a single emblem only, not a sheet, mockup or comparison. Reference image 1 is the identity to preserve, not an image to paste unchanged.
Preserve the hexagonal technological shield, bright cyan circular energy core, three radial mechanical spokes, and dark gunmetal circuitry. Cyan and silver on dark steel. Remove all name banners and small lettering; retain a strong compact hexagon silhouette.
